item.title: Top 5 Steps to Fix CSS Issues in Blazor .NET 8 Preview 6
item.description:
Facing CSS issues in Blazor .NET 8 Preview 6? You’re not alone. Many developers have encountered problems where CSS files aren’t served correctly, leading to unstyled pages. In this post, we’ll walk through five essential steps to resolve these issues, ensuring that your Blazor app displays as intended. Whether you’re dealing with misconfigured paths or conflicts with Razor components, this guide has got you covered.

Top 5 Steps to Fix CSS Issues in Blazor .NET 8 Preview 6

1. Understanding the Root Cause

The first step to solving CSS issues in Blazor .NET 8 Preview 6 is identifying the root cause. In many cases, the problem arises from how Blazor handles routing and static file serving. When the route matches a CSS file’s name, Blazor may mistakenly interpret it as a page route, leading to the file not being served correctly.
